title: Bluepinkgill Mushroom
body:
Description

Bluepinkgill Mushrooms are a type of Mushroom found in Uncertainty Cave.

The mushroom has two different variations one that only has the main shoot and cap and another that includes a large root system on the ground (the root system is also detached when the main log is cut down) . The mushroom is a light blue and slightly transparent. The cap emits water particles when a player is nearby, when processed it loses it's transparent properties.


Due to the area containing of many water holes that can complicate harvesting it is recomended to have a refined scuba tank to allow to collect logs that fall to the seafloor. to reach the log you walk on the provided stone pathways or parkour across the root systems.

They were added in the version 118.0( Ferwater Revamp) update on May 30, 2026.
